newsitem.title: USA: USDA expects to make announcement on EU meat row.
newsitem.headline: USDA expects to make announcement on EU meat row.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department expects to make an announcement on long-running trade talks with the European Union over meat import rules some time after 1200 EDT/1600 GMT, a USDA official said Wednesday.
Washington has said it would remove more than 100 European meat and poultry packing plants from its list of approved exporters if a deal is not reached by April 30.
That would halt $300 million worth of European meat shipments to the U.S., mostly Danish pork products.
Poultry issues have proved to be the major obstacle toward reaching an agreement, and U.S. meat and poultry officials said Tuesday they were not optimistic a deal could be worked out on poultry.
Earlier in Brussels, EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler told a news conference the two sides were trying to agree on a deal Wednesday.
